english.title: Make false statement in purported compliance re s.62 disclosure / s.63 production of documents - SOCA 2005

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 61 of the Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005 provides that this offence applies to any offence listed in Schedule 2 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, offences under sections 15, 16, 17 or 18 of the Terrorism Act 2000, offences under section 170 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, any offence under section 17 of the Theft Act 1968, any offence under section 1 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981, any offence under section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Until the commencement of section 282 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty on summary conviction will be - Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
